## Decisions (with @rationale)

- `tile({"factors": [128], "loop": "i"})` :: Tile the M-dimension (i) with factor 128. A 128-row block tile is the standard GEMM output-block height for Ampere, bala
- `tile({"factors": [128], "loop": "j"})` :: Tile the N-dimension (j) with factor 128 to match the i-tile. A 128×128 output block per CTA maximizes data reuse in sha
- `parallel({"mapping": {"i": "threadblock.y"}})` :: Map the M-dimension (i) tiles to threadblock.y. This assigns each 128-row output tile to a distinct CTA row, enabling al
- `parallel({"mapping": {"j": "threadblock.x"}})` :: Map the N-dimension (j) tiles to threadblock.x. This creates a 2D CTA grid of (M/128) × (N/128) = 8×8 = 64 CTAs, providi
- `vectorize({"loop": "j", "width": 8})` :: Vectorize the j (N) inner loop with width 8. For FP16, width-8 maps to 128-bit (float4) vector loads/stores from global
